inspection.show_create_table:
CREATE TABLE `coreiq_av_earnings_call_transcripts` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `source` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `ticker` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `quarter` varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  `year` smallint NOT NULL,
  `q` tinyint NOT NULL,
  `transcript_text` longtext,
  `has_transcript` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `title` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `event_datetime_utc` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `fetched_at_utc` datetime NOT NULL,
  `raw_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `raw_json_sha1` char(40) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error` text,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_src_ticker_quarter` (`source`,`ticker`,`quarter`),
  KEY `idx_ticker` (`ticker`),
  KEY `idx_year_q` (`year`,`q`),
  KEY `idx_ec_ticker_quarter` (`ticker`,`quarter`),
  KEY `idx_has_transcript_year` (`has_transcript`,`year`),
  KEY `idx_has_transcript_ticker` (`has_transcript`,`ticker`),
  KEY `idx_covering_transcript_lookup` (`has_transcript`,`ticker`,`transcript_text`(100)),
  KEY `idx_ec_ticker_year_q` (`ticker`,`year`,`q`),
  KEY `idx_ec_ticker_year_q_event` (`ticker`,`year`,`q`,`event_datetime_utc`),
  KEY `idx_ec_cover_transcript_fetch` (`ticker`,`year`,`q`,`has_transcript`,`transcript_text`(100)),
  KEY `idx_ec_cover_company_lookup` (`has_transcript`,`transcript_text`(10),`ticker`),
  KEY `idx_ec_cover_ticker_years` (`ticker`,`has_transcript`,`transcript_text`(10),`year`),
  KEY `idx_ec_cover_ticker_quarters` (`ticker`,`year`,`has_transcript`,`transcript_text`(10),`q`),
  KEY `idx_ec_list_ordered` (`ticker`,`has_transcript`,`year`,`q`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `idx_transcript_fulltext_search` (`transcript_text`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=204098 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

query_contract: Require native MySQL 8.0, ACTIVE ngram parser, ngram_token_size=2, and utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci source collation.

AND quoted ASCII alphanumeric runs of at least two characters as positional ngram phrases, then verify binary LOWER literal matching with Python's dotted-I lowercase expansion. A quoted whole query can miss punctuation/phrase cases.
For ASCII queries this follows the product's lowercase literal contract; accent-insensitive collation expansions such as strasse/Straße and ae/æ are not matches.
Non-ASCII queries and terms with no usable bigram retain the exact scan fallback; this migration does not guarantee fast Unicode, one-character, or symbol-only negatives.
The isolated 23-term fixture proves the tested cases, not arbitrary Unicode or production performance.
